svg.text: FIGURE 4.9: UML COMPONENT DIAGRAM — SYSTEM MODULARITY & INTERFACES
Frontend React Components, Backend Express Middleware & Controllers, and Mongoose Data Access Objects

g.text: • Stores JWT Bearer Claims in Memory
«subsystem» BACKEND APPLICATION SERVICES & EXECUTION CONTROLLERS (EXPRESS & NODE.JS)
• HS256 JWT Token Signing with JTI
• Strips Hidden Tests from Public API
«subsystem» PERSISTENCE & DATA ACCESS OBJECT LAYER (MONGOOSE 8 ODM & MONGODB ATLAS)
UML COMPONENT MODELING CONVENTIONS & DEPENDENCY PERIMETERS:
Presentation Layer: React Contexts, Hook Providers & Monaco Engine
Business Logic Layer: Express Controllers, In-Memory Sandbox & Socket Gateway
Data Layer: Mongoose ODM Schema Models with Pre-Save Hooks & B-Tree Indexes
Loose Coupling Design: Frontend components interact exclusively via HTTP/WebSocket ports; zero backend implementation details leaked to client bundles.
